memory.development_feedback: All supplied runs reached the 1100-action limit without success; some showed partial scores. No primitive-level failure trace was supplied, so no particular grasp, trajectory, or placement failure can be identified.
lessons: Parse object names at the final underscore; category names may contain underscores.
Assign distinct baskets to distinct categories and preserve unambiguous existing category placements.
Normalize supplied downward quaternions and use the supplied contact offset, minimum tool height, and basket release height.
Visible instance keys are not persistent tracking identities; refresh perception and associate by category and nearby position.
Gripper and motion returns do not establish grasp or placement success. Do not retry uncertain manipulation.
memory.repair_strategy: Use a finite target list, exclude objects already inside baskets, avoid repeated manipulation attempts, and terminate when transfer state becomes uncertain.

proposer.model_feedback: all development metrics plus full-row evidence digest

rationale: The policy uses only the supplied scene, approach, and gripper RPCs. It groups observed objects by category, assigns separate baskets, and performs bounded pick-and-place sequences with normalized orientations and explicit clearance. Fresh observations reduce reliance on stale instance keys. The feedback motivates bounded work and no uncertain retries, but does not establish the cause of earlier failures or validate this policy.
